title: alyssum repens f. molliusculum
intro: Alyssum repens f. molliusculum, commonly known as Creeping White Alyssum, is a low-growing, spreading perennial herb belonging to the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its delicate white flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Creeping White Alyssum include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
